entries.speaker: Man's Voice
entries.en: ...Excuse me, sir.

entries.speaker: Shadow Dealer
entries.en: You haven't completed your registration[n]yet. Come this way.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: It seems we have no choice but to do[n]as he says. Let us go.

entries.speaker: Shadow Dealer
entries.en: Welcome to the members floor.[n]We received word of your coming.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: So all of this is going according to her[n]plan... I cannot help but feel we're being[n]manipulated here.

entries.speaker: Shadow Dealer
entries.en: First off, we would like to extend[n]a welcome gift to you.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: He's just giving them to us!?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Perhaps this is a show of confidence.[n]It seems she truly has no intention[n]of losing.

entries.speaker: Shadow Dealer
entries.en: Now, to the left of the counter is the dice[n]game area, while to the right are the slots.

entries.speaker: Shadow Dealer
entries.en: Please head to whichever strikes your[n]fancy.

entries.speaker: Shadow Dealer
entries.en: By the way, we believe beginners will[n]find the [clr 2]dice game[clr 27] area more suitable[n]to their tastes.

entries.speaker: Shadow Dealer
entries.en: Furthermore... this is a map of the[n]members floor. Please accept it.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: That means we should probably start[n]with the dice game... right?

entries.speaker: Shadow Dealer
entries.en: Ah, one more thing. Casino coins can be[n][clr 2]exchanged for prizes[clr 27] at this very counter.

entries.speaker: Shadow Dealer
entries.en: Please feel free to ask more about this[n]service.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Prizes? What kinds of things can we get?

entries.speaker: Shadow Dealer
entries.en: Our most desired prize is a [clr 2]member's[n]card[clr 27] for entry into the high limit floor.

entries.speaker: Shadow Dealer
entries.en: However, the price of exchange for this[n]item is [clr 2]50,000 coins[clr 27].

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I see... I believe I have figured out[n]Sae-san's intent behind this.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: She wants us to obtain that card by[n]winning coins in the casino.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: That's absurd! [clr 2]50,000 coins[clr 27]!?

entries.speaker: Shadow Dealer
entries.en: *chuckle* We also allow players to[n]borrow coins if need be, up to the[n]current total on their card.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I don't wanna do that! Owin' cash to a[n]weird-ass casino in someone's head is[n]way too weird!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Oh well... Standing around here won't[n]get us anywhere. So, should we head to[n]this dice game?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Actually, do you mind if I speak to you[n]all beforehand? There is something on[n]my mind.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Dice games, slot machines...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: It would not surprise me in the least[n]if all the games here were somehow[n]rigged.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: You think she's cheatin'!?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Remember, this is a courthouse in the[n]real world. Sae-san is quite particular[n]about "winning" here.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: To compound that, defendants in Japan[n]are prosecuted at a 99.9% success rate—[n]defendants are nearly always found guilty.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: What!? How can a rate like that really be[n]possible? Are all those verdicts accurate?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: No... The investigators are merely human.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Then...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: You are not the first to point out the[n]rigged nature of this system. The[n]prosecution is nigh-unbeatable.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: That's why cases of false accusation[n]cause such a stir: they are exceedingly[n]rare.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: But it's total bullshit gettin' arrested[n]even when you're not guilty!

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Indeed—and if we do not hurry, the[n]Phantom Thieves will fall victim to[n]a similar fate.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: We're going to win this, no matter what.
